summary: Nova Scotia tower on the hill in Ardoise, Hants, Nova Scotia; listeners reported it closed in 2009, and the province dismantled its towers after 2015. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific sources are a 2009 scanner-listener list and a Weebly stub that gives the name and location. The list says the tower might have been closed by 2009, and it gives that as an area listeners' report. The CBC article gives 2015 for decommissioning of the province's towers as a group and does not name Willow Hill, so the 2009 and 2015 dates cannot both be tied to this tower and neither is confirmed. Search snippets mention other figures (a 32-tower count, a 2015 demolition); those pages were not fetched, so they are not used. No build date, height, design or site description was found.
